## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass when frontend/domain code changes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and Rust tests pass for Rust changes.
- [ ] New scanner/provider behavior includes contract or regression tests.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or an explicit reason they are not applicable.
- [ ] Persistence or protocol changes include migration/compatibility details.
- [ ] No real secrets, proprietary source, private paths, or scanner credentials are included.
